subtitle: Cross-check of 19/Oct/2026, 15th day of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 19/Oct, 15:42 BRT, the twenty-six national polls conducted after the vote, including the five of 19/Oct (AtlasIntel, BTG/Nexus, Futura/100% Cidades, PoderData/Aya and DataTrends), the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally and the press flow of 18 and 19/Oct, with the Band debate.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 23.50% (cumulative volume USD 26.66M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 19/Oct, 15:42 BRT, rises 3.00pp against the confirmed reading of 18/Oct at 17:44 BRT, published in the previous update. BALLOT: 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLLS: behind in the five national polls of 19/Oct, with 47.6% to 49.8% in AtlasIntel and 45.9% to 46.5% in BTG/Nexus; 46.4% to 44.6% in Vox Brasil of 18/Oct.
fortes: He leads both Vox Brasil polls conducted after the vote: 46.4% to 44.6% on 18/Oct, within the 2.15-point margin, with 51% of the valid votes, and 44.2% to 42.7% on 09/Oct.

Between each pollster's previous and current wave, the distance to Flávio Bolsonaro in total votes goes from 5.4 to 2.2 points in AtlasIntel, from 3 to 0.6 in BTG/Nexus and from 1.5 to 0.8 in Futura/100% Cidades, and in valid votes from 6.2 to 3 points in DataTrends.
🏆 Counting the closed contracts, his contract is still the one with the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 26.66M.
fracos: He stands at 23.50% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 19/Oct, 15:42 BRT, and Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over him is 53.35pp.

He trails in twenty-three of the twenty-six national polls conducted after the vote, among them the five of 19/Oct: 47.6% to 49.8% in AtlasIntel, 45.9% to 46.5% in BTG/Nexus, 47.5% to 48.3% in Futura/100% Cidades, and 48% of the valid votes in PoderData/Aya and 48.5% in DataTrends.
He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 1.87 points behind Flávio Bolsonaro, with 45.16% of the valid votes against 47.03%.
In AtlasIntel of 19/Oct the government is disapproved by 52.3% and approved by 46.2%; in BTG/Nexus, disapproved by 48.8% and approved by 47.2%.
candidates.analise: Lula stands at 23.50% in the winner contract (cumulative volume USD 26.66M), confirmed reading of 19/Oct, 15:42 BRT, and rises 3.00pp against the confirmed reading of 18/Oct at 17:44 BRT, published in the previous update. 🗳️ He had 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). 📊 Five new national polls came out on 19/Oct, all with Flávio Bolsonaro ahead. AtlasIntel, commissioned by Bloomberg, with 4,998 interviews from 13 to 18/Oct, gives him 49.8% and Lula 47.6% in total votes and 51.1% to 48.9% in valid votes (Estadão, Brasil de Fato and Poder360). BTG/Nexus, with 2,002 telephone interviews from 16 to 18/Oct, gives 46.5% to 45.9% in total votes and 50.3% to 49.7% in valid votes (Estadão, Congresso em Foco and UOL). Futura/100% Cidades, with 2,000 telephone interviews on 16 and 17/Oct, gives 48.3% to 47.5% in total votes and 50.4% to 49.6% in valid votes (Money Times and CNN Brasil). PoderData/Aya, with 3,000 automated telephone interviews from 16 to 18/Oct, gives 52% to 48% in valid votes (Poder360, UOL and Exame), and DataTrends, with 2,000 automated telephone interviews from 15 to 17/Oct, 51.5% to 48.5% in valid votes (the Edmar Lyra and Mário Flávio blogs). Between each pollster's previous and current wave, Flávio Bolsonaro's lead in total votes goes from 5.4 to 2.2 points in AtlasIntel, from 3 to 0.6 in BTG/Nexus and from 1.5 to 0.8 in Futura/100% Cidades; in valid votes, it goes from 6.2 to 3 points in DataTrends and from a tie to 4 points in PoderData/Aya. In Vox Brasil of 18/Oct he has 46.4% against 44.6%. After the promulgation, Lula said the 6x1 work schedule will return if Flávio Bolsonaro wins the election (O Globo and Valor), and on 13/Oct he announced Prospera MEI, with forgiveness of individual microentrepreneurs' debts estimated at R$ 12.6 billion (Poder360 and Estadão). 🎙️ The first debate of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) was on Band, on the night of 18/Oct: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro traded accusations over [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) and the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) frauds, and Lula proposed that both open their families' bank and phone records; Flávio Bolsonaro replied that his accounts are declared to the tax authority (O Globo, CNN Brasil and Folha de S.Paulo). In a qualitative assessment carried out during the debate with 30 groups of voters, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) gave Flávio Bolsonaro 82 points and Lula 79, on a scale of 0 to 100 (O Globo and O Antagonista). Globo's debate is scheduled for 23/Oct, two days before the vote. On the afternoon of 18/Oct, Flávio Bolsonaro held a rally on Avenida Paulista (EBC and Folha de S.Paulo). ⚖️ On 19/Oct, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) Justice Marco Aurélio Bellizze gave Meta 24 hours to prove it complied with the court's orders on the distribution of content and ads from Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with a daily fine that can reach R$ 1 million (Estadão and Valor), and the ANPD, Brazil's data protection authority, gave the company five days to explain the suspension of accounts and the removal of posts (G1 and Metrópoles). In a statement on 16/Oct, Meta had attributed to a gap in its safeguards the fact that its AI produced campaign material for Flávio Bolsonaro and not for Lula, and denied interfering in the election (O Globo). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the campaign agenda: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 76.85% (cumulative volume USD 23.05M) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 19/Oct, 15:42 BRT, falls 2.40pp against the confirmed reading of 18/Oct at 17:44 BRT, published in the previous update. BALLOT: 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). POLLS: ahead in twenty-three of the twenty-six post-vote national polls and in the five of 19/Oct, with 49.8% to 47.6% in AtlasIntel and 46.5% to 45.9% in BTG/Nexus; 44.6% to 46.4% in Vox Brasil of 18/Oct.
fortes: He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) ahead, with 47.03% of the valid votes against Lula's 45.16%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally.
He stands at 76.85% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 19/Oct, 15:42 BRT.

He leads twenty-three of the twenty-six national polls conducted after the vote, among them the five of 19/Oct: 49.8% to 47.6% in AtlasIntel, 46.5% to 45.9% in BTG/Nexus, 48.3% to 47.5% in Futura/100% Cidades, and 52% of the valid votes in PoderData/Aya and 51.5% in DataTrends.
He has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema and Michel Temer.
Among Ronaldo Caiado's voters, he has 56% against 15% in Ipespe, 54.9% against 26.9% in AtlasIntel and 57% against 19% in PoderData/Aya.
fracos: He trails in both Vox Brasil polls conducted after the vote, with 44.6% against 46.4% on 18/Oct and 42.7% against 44.2% on 09/Oct; between each pollster's previous and current wave, his lead in total votes goes from 5.4 to 2.2 points in AtlasIntel, from 3 to 0.6 in BTG/Nexus and from 1.5 to 0.8 in Futura/100% Cidades.

⚖️ On 18/Oct, Estadão reported, and Folha de S.Paulo and G1 confirmed, that the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) (PF) took to the Supreme Court an investigation into suspected money laundering involving the lawyer Willer Tomaz, his companies and Flávio Bolsonaro, with Alexandre de Moraes drawn as rapporteur; the case moved up from the Federal Court in Rio Grande do Sul on 08/Oct because of the senator's privileged forum, and the Prosecutor General's Office (PGR) supported opening it (G1 and Gazeta do Povo). It is the second inquiry in which he is under investigation at the court; the first, with André Mendonça, looks into Daniel Vorcaro's money for the film Dark Horse. Flávio Bolsonaro and Willer Tomaz say they are friends and deny having business together (G1 and Gazeta do Povo).

🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro's arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): third place, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 08/Oct (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).
fortes: He finished third, with 2.89% of the valid votes, ahead of Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado.
The [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno)'s third-place book was resolved in his favour.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid more for Renan Santos, 47.50%, and for Ronaldo Caiado, 30.00%, than for him, 23.70%.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in third, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. The first round's third-place book, which on the eve paid 23.70% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, was resolved in his favour. 🤝 On 08/Oct he declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round (G1, Estadão and CNN Brasil).

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): fourth place, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): he backs neither of the two.
fortes: He finished fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes, ahead of Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18%.
His contract in the winner book closed with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, and third place went to Augusto Cury.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book, behind Lula's. On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, and it was resolved in favour of Augusto Cury. 🤝 On the night of 04/Oct he said he backs neither of the two in the second round and freed Missão's activists to choose (Gazeta do Povo and Agência Brasil).

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema, with 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad did not run for President. PRICE: the three winner contracts were closed and resolved at zero.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally (100% of polling sections) and the closing of the winner contracts after the first round.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 2.18% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.82M cumulative.
caiado.fortes: He declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct, with governor Daniel Vilela (O Globo and VEJA).
caiado.fracos: He finished fifth, behind Renan Santos, and the PSD decided on neutrality in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
haddad.fortes: The top of his series in the winner contract was 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He was not measured by any national poll in a presidential scenario or in a second-round pairing.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 0.27% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
zema.fortes: ⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of his voters would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), the largest transfer among the names measured (O Globo).
zema.fracos: He had 0.27% of the valid votes. He declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on 05/Oct, and Novo declared support for him on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).

candidates.analise: 🗳️ Ronaldo Caiado finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fifth, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema had 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad ran for governor of São Paulo, not for President. The three contracts in the winner book were closed by Polymarket and resolved at zero. 🤝 Romeu Zema declared his vote for Flávio Bolsonaro on the night of 05/Oct (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo), and Novo, his party, declared support on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital). Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro in Goiânia on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), even with the PSD neutral in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro on 06/Oct (O Globo and VEJA), and Romeu Zema declared his vote for him on 05/Oct, followed by Novo on 07/Oct (G1 and CartaCapital).
⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of Romeu Zema's voters and 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (O Globo).
fracos: The two are out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and the winner contracts of all three names were resolved at zero.
Fernando Haddad did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).

On the afternoon of 18/Oct, Flávio Bolsonaro held a rally on Avenida Paulista (EBC and Folha de S.Paulo). ⚖️ On 18/Oct, Estadão reported, and Folha de S.Paulo and G1 confirmed, that the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) (PF) took to the Supreme Court an investigation into suspected money laundering involving the lawyer Willer Tomaz, his companies and Flávio Bolsonaro, with Alexandre de Moraes drawn as rapporteur; the case moved up from the Federal Court in Rio Grande do Sul on 08/Oct because of the senator's privileged forum, and the Prosecutor General's Office (PGR) supported opening it (G1 and Gazeta do Povo). It is the second inquiry in which he is under investigation at the court; the first, with André Mendonça, looks into Daniel Vorcaro's money for the film Dark Horse. Flávio Bolsonaro and Willer Tomaz say they are friends and deny having business together (G1 and Gazeta do Povo). ⚖️ On 19/Oct, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) Justice Marco Aurélio Bellizze gave Meta 24 hours to prove it complied with the court's orders on the distribution of content and ads from Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with a daily fine that can reach R$ 1 million (Estadão and Valor), and the ANPD, Brazil's data protection authority, gave the company five days to explain the suspension of accounts and the removal of posts (G1 and Metrópoles). In a statement on 16/Oct, Meta had attributed to a gap in its safeguards the fact that its AI produced campaign material for Flávio Bolsonaro and not for Lula, and denied interfering in the election (O Globo). 🤝 Flávio Bolsonaro has the declared support of Podemos, Augusto Cury, Novo, ACM Neto, PP, União Brasil, Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, Michel Temer and the MDB, which on 13/Oct formalized the support of 17 state branches (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo); 10 MDB branches, from the North and Northeast, declared support for Lula (Estadão, Valor and CartaCapital). PSDB stayed neutral. Lula has the support of UP, PSTU and PCB (CNN Brasil and G1). On 16/Oct, former Fortaleza mayor Roberto Cláudio, who ran in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) as Ciro Gomes's running mate in Ceará, declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro; Ciro has not commented (G1). Renan Santos said on 15/Oct that he sees a greater danger of concentration of power in a Flávio Bolsonaro victory, but that he does not back Lula and will not vote (O Globo and Estadão). 📜 On 16/Oct Congress promulgated the constitutional amendment (PEC) ending the 6x1 work schedule, which cuts the maximum working week from 44 to 40 hours; the Senate approved it on the night of 14/Oct by 75 votes to 1 in both rounds of voting (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Valor), and Flávio Bolsonaro had said on 13/Oct that he would vote in favour (UOL and CNN Brasil). In BTG/Nexus of 19/Oct, 66.2% support ending the 6x1 schedule (UOL and Diário do Grande ABC). 📊 The next national polls registered with the TSE come out on 20/Oct (Veritá and Alfa), 21/Oct (Quaest, Palver, Gerp, 100 Cidades and Ideia), 22/Oct (Datafolha, PoderData and Indexa) and 23/Oct (Vox Brasil, Ipespe, Veritá, DataTrends and Alfa). ⛔ The panel does not attribute price moves to the polls, the debate, the inquiry or the day's acts: it measures the sides with each one's timestamps.
